content.title: Film Recommendation: Arrival
content.body:
Arrival is a thoughtful science fiction film that focuses on language and communication rather than conventional alien invasion tropes, offering a more cerebral approach to first contact.

## Notes
The user's description highlights their appreciation for science fiction that explores intellectual themes like linguistics and communication rather than action-focused narratives.
